gitCommit.subject: fix(canvas): reverse top-level layer order direction to match frame children (#1395)
gitCommit.body:
fix(canvas): reverse top-level layer order direction to match frame children (#1395)

The moveObjectUp/Down/ToFront/ToBack methods had opposite direction logic
for top-level objects vs frame children. Both arrays follow the same Konva
rendering rule (higher index = rendered later = visually on top), but
top-level branch used idx-1 for "up" while frame children correctly used
childIdx+1. This caused layer order buttons to have opposite effects
depending on whether the object was inside a frame or not.

- Reverse top-level branch direction in all four methods
- Fix isAtTop/isAtBottom boundary checks in FloatingQuickActions
- Frame children branch (parentId) unchanged — already correct

Co-authored-by: Jack Tsai <jtsai0606@gmail.com>
